entities.name: William D. Williamson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Durkee Williamson was the second governor of Maine, and one of the first representatives from Maine in the United States House of Representatives. He was a member of the Democratic-Republican Party. Williamson was also an early historian of Maine.
